disclaimer: Prototype mapping of commonly cited packaged-commodity declarations associated with the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011. This is NOT official legal text and MUST NOT replace notified rules. Official packs can replace this file later.

rules.description: Commodity / product identity on the principal display panel.
rules.requirement: A common or generic name of the commodity should be present on the package.
rules.legal_reference: LM(PC) Rules, 2011 — prototype mapping (name of commodity)

rules.description: Name of manufacturer, packer or importer.
rules.requirement: Name of manufacturer / packer / importer should be declared.

rules.description: Address of manufacturer, packer or importer.
rules.requirement: Complete address enabling identification of the premises should be declared.
Net quantity should be declared in terms of standard units of weight, measure or number.

rules.description: Maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes.
rules.requirement: MRP (inclusive of all taxes) should be declared in Indian rupees.

rules.description: Month and year of manufacture, packing or import.
rules.requirement: Month and year of manufacture / packing / import should be declared in a parseable form.
rules.legal_reference: LM(PC) Rules, 2011 — prototype mapping (date of manufacture/packing/import)

rules.requirement: Consumer care name and at least one contact channel (telephone and/or email) should be declared.
rules.legal_reference: LM(PC) Rules, 2011 (as amended) — prototype mapping (consumer care)

rules.description: Country of origin for imported packages.
rules.requirement: If the package is indicated as imported, country of origin should be declared.
Unit should be a recognised standard unit (g, kg, ml, l, number/pcs, etc.).
Conflicting or multiple distinct MRP values should be flagged for review.
rules.legal_reference: Prototype operational check — not a verbatim statutory clause
